title: Convert an XLSForm to a Microsoft Word or PDF Document
text: Front matter: form title, version form ID, language, date generation, legend explains marks used document. Groups: headings numbered depth. Repeat groups carry “Repeat …” line describes repeat count. Rosters: repeat group six simple questions (text, numbers, choices, dates) drawn table one row per member one column per question, code lists skip logic . fixed repeat_count sets number rows, otherwise roster_rows (default 5). Use repeat_layout = "copies" print questions instead, repeat_copies times. Grids: group table-list appearance, label question followed list-nolabel questions, drawn one grid row per question column per choice, questions share choice list eight choices. Questions: number label, * required questions, hint italics, variable name show_variable_names = TRUE. “Ask ” “Constraint” lines follow answer area. Single choice (select_one): hollow circle choice. Lists seven fewer choices print one column; longer lists print columns. answer skips later questions, choice shows go next, example “→ Go Q5” (turn include_skips = FALSE). Multiple choice (select_multiple): hollow square choice. Rank: box beside choice write rank. Long choice lists: list longer max_choices, paper form shows code box respondent write code, compact table every choice code. Text numbers: bordered write-box. Multiline text gets taller box. Date time: printed pattern (dd/mm/yyyy, hh:mm). Location: latitude, longitude accuracy fields geopoint. geotrace geoshape get prompt reference line. Media: image printed size, scaled fit (questions 2 inches tall, choices 0.6 inches). missing file prints placeholder name, convertxlsform warns . Notes: printed without number. Hidden types (calculate, start, end, deviceid similar) left unless include_hidden = TRUE.

Options accept --name value --name=value. -o, --output PATH: output file folder (default: next form). -f, --format docx|pdf|: output format (default: extension --output, else docx). -l, --lang LANG: language code, name header suffix. --lang2 LANG: second language, printed first. --flat-numbers: number questions 1, 2, 3 instead 1.1, 1.2. ---relevants: hide skip logic. ---skips: hide "Go " instructions next choices. ---constraints: hide constraints. ---hints: hide hints. ---choice-codes: hide choice codes. --show-names: show variable names. --include-hidden: include calculate, start, end similar rows. --media-root DIR: folder media external files (default: folder form). --title TEXT: form title. --page-size A4|letter (default A4). --landscape: landscape orientation. --margins : margins inches (default 1). --font NAME (default Arial) --font-size PT (default 11). --font-cs NAME: font complex scripts Bengali Arabic. --rtl, --ltr: force right--left left--right layout (default: script language). --template FILE: reference .docx styles. --max-choices N: longest choice list printed full (default 30). --repeat-copies N: copies repeat group (default 1). --repeat-layout auto|copies|roster: repeat groups drawn (default auto). --roster-rows N: rows roster repeat count number (default 5). --overwrite: replace existing output. --quiet: progress messages. -h, --help: show help stop. --version: show package version stop.

text: xlsform Path XLSForm (.xlsx, .xlsm .xls). output Output file folder, see Details. NULL (default) writes next xlsform. format "docx", "pdf", "" c("docx", "pdf"). NULL (default) takes format extension output, "docx" extension. lang Language use: code ("fr"), name ("French") full header suffix ("French (fr)"). NULL (default) uses default_language settings sheet, first language found. See xlsform_languages(). ... options, named. Defaults brackets. nested_serial_numbers (TRUE): number questions inside groups 1.1, 1.2; FALSE gives flat numbers 1, 2, 3. include_relevants (TRUE): show skip logic ("Ask : ..."). include_constraints (TRUE): show constraints. include_hints (TRUE): show hints guidance hints. include_choice_name (TRUE): show choice code choice label. show_variable_names (FALSE): show variable name question. include_hidden (FALSE): include hidden types calculate, start end. media_root (folder xlsform): images, audio, video external choice files looked . title (NULL): form title; overrides form_title settings sheet. page_size ("A4"): "A4" "letter". orientation ("portrait"): "portrait" "landscape". margins_in (1): page margins inches, 0 2. font_family ("Arial"): font document. font_size (11): base font size points, 6 20. template (NULL): reference .docx whose styles used. max_choices (30): choice lists longer get code box layout instead printed list. strings (NULL): named list overriding connective phrases "Ask ". repeat_copies (1): number blank copies printed repeat group, 1 20. font_family_cs (NULL): font complex scripts; chosen language NULL, using first installed font list script (Bengali: Noto Sans Bengali, fonts ship macOS Windows). lang2 (NULL): second language, printed new line label, hint choice first. See xlsform_languages(). include_skips (TRUE): print "Go " instructions next choices single-choice questions whose answer skips later questions. rtl (NULL): lay document right left. NULL decides script first language (Arabic Hebrew right left). repeat_layout ("auto"): repeat groups drawn. "roster" draws table one row per member one column per question (10 simple questions); "copies" prints questions repeat_copies times; "auto" uses roster repeats 6 simple questions copies otherwise. roster_rows (5): number rows roster repeat count fixed number (1 50). overwrite (FALSE): replace existing output files. verbose (TRUE): print progress messages.

title: List the languages of an XLSForm — xlsform_languages
code: xlsform_languages(xlsform)

title: List the languages of an XLSForm — xlsform_languages
text: xlsform Path XLSForm (.xlsx .xls).

title: List the languages of an XLSForm — xlsform_languages
text: data.frame one row per language columns suffix (text ::), code, name default (TRUE language used lang requested: default_language settings sheet matches, otherwise first language). data.frame rows single-language form.

title: List the languages of an XLSForm — xlsform_languages
code: path <- system.file("extdata", "multilang", "multilang.xlsx",                     package = "convertxlsform") xlsform_languages(path) #>         suffix code    name default #> 1 English (en)   en English    TRUE #> 2 Bengali (bn)   bn Bengali   FALSE

title: Outline of an XLSForm — xlsform_outline
text: Parses XLSForm returns one row item appear paper form: sections, questions, notes end repeat groups. shows question numbers, answer type, number choices, skip logic constraints plain language, form can checked converted.

title: Outline of an XLSForm — xlsform_outline
code: xlsform_outline(xlsform, lang = NULL, ...)

title: Outline of an XLSForm — xlsform_outline
text: xlsform Path XLSForm (.xlsx .xls). lang Language use: code ("fr"), name ("French") full header suffix ("French (fr)"). NULL uses default_language settings sheet, first language found. See xlsform_languages(). ... options: nested_serial_numbers, include_relevants, include_constraints, include_hints, include_hidden, media_root, max_choices (lists longer get code box layout), strings, show_variable_names, title conversion options. Page font options accepted effect .

title: Outline of an XLSForm — xlsform_outline
text: data.frame one row per block columns row (Excel row form), serial (question number, NA unnumbered), depth (number enclosing groups), block ("section", "section_end", "note" "question"), kind (question kind, example "select_one", "begin_group", "begin_repeat", "end_repeat", "note"), name, label, required, n_choices (choices select rank question, counting "" row), relevant_text, constraint_text (constraint message form one, else humanized expression) layout (select rank questions: "list", "columns" "code_box", number choices max_choices; NA otherwise). label may contain line breaks (\n).

title: Outline of an XLSForm — xlsform_outline
code: path <- system.file("extdata", "minimal", "minimal.xlsx",                     package = "convertxlsform") out <- xlsform_outline(path) out[, c("serial", "block", "kind", "name", "relevant_text")] #>   serial    block            kind            name relevant_text #> 1   <NA>     note            note           intro          <NA> #> 2      1 question            text respondent_name          <NA> #> 3      2 question          number             age          <NA> #> 4      3 question      select_one    water_source          <NA> #> 5      4 question select_multiple       water_use          <NA> #> 6      5  section     begin_group       follow_up   Q3 is "Tap" #> 7    5.1 question            text    tap_location      Q2 >= 18  # \donttest{ # A multilingual form: another language, with flat question numbers path_ml <- system.file("extdata", "multilang", "multilang.xlsx",                        package = "convertxlsform") out <- xlsform_outline(path_ml, lang = "bn", nested_serial_numbers = FALSE) head(out[, c("serial", "name")], 5) #>   serial         name #> 1   <NA>       groupA #> 2      1   surveydate #> 3      2     enumname #> 4   <NA> note_consent #> 5      3      consent # }

title: convertxlsform 0.4.0
text: “Go ” instructions. single-choice question whose answer hides later questions now shows, next choice, question go next, example “→ Go Q5”, “Go end”. instruction worked relevant expressions questions follow; left result depends answers leave repeat group. include_skips = FALSE (---skips) turns . Roster tables repeat groups. repeat simple questions (text, numbers, single multiple choice, dates, times, barcodes, ranges) drawn table one row per member one column per question, code lists skip logic . fixed repeat_count sets number rows, otherwise roster_rows (default 5). repeat_layout = "auto" (default) uses roster repeats 6 questions, "roster" allows 10, "copies" keeps earlier layout. Grids table-list list-nolabel. group table-list appearance whose questions share choice list, label question followed list-nolabel questions, drawn one grid row per question column per choice. label question gives column headings takes number. Bilingual documents. lang2 (--lang2) prints second language new line label, hint, constraint message choice first. Right--left layout. Forms Arabic Hebrew laid right left: paragraphs, tables page. rtl = TRUE FALSE (--rtl, --ltr) overrides detection. entities sheet ODK entity forms read. entity lists named front matter, show_variable_names = TRUE question’s save_to property shown next name. XLSForm types spellings: background-geopoint (hidden), osm (captured device), pyxform aliases select apply, select_all_that_apply, select1, int, string, gps, location photo. XLSForm functions written plain language skip logic, constraints choice filters: string-length(), regex(), selected-(), jr:choice-name(), count(), position(..), indexed-repeat(), (), coalesce(), int(), round(), number(), date() decimal-date-time(). age check int((today() - ${dob}) div 365.25) >= 18 reads “years since Q3 (dob) >= 18”. (), uuid() pulldata() shown “calculated value”. wording string tables, can translated overridden strings (#20). XML choice files read select_one_from_file select_multiple_from_file, CSV files already (#21). Language names recognized many headers without code, English script, example label::Spanish, label::Español label::বাংলা, built-strings language used. lang = "Arabic" also finds column headed label::ar (#18). title: convertxlsform 0.3.0
text: convertxlsform() writes Word document (.docx) default. format = "pdf" format = c("docx", "pdf") also writes PDF. output location, format overwrite rules follow arguments, function returns paths invisibly. PDF output converts Word document LibreOffice. Microsoft Word used doconv package LibreOffice found. docx_to_pdf() has_libreoffice() exported. cli() runs conversion terminal, example Rscript -e 'convertxlsform::cli()' form.xlsx --format pdf. Scripts can use quit(status = convertxlsform::cli()) get exit status. xlsform_outline() returns numbered form data frame, checking form conversion. xlsform_languages() lists languages form marks default. Language columns read label::English (en), label::en label::English. lang argument accepts code, name full suffix. blank translated cell falls back plain column, default language. Headers common language name , label::French, also match ISO 639-1 code (lang = "fr"). Skip logic, constraints choice filters written plain language. Expressions read shown written. Connective phrases “Ask ” come built-English French tables. strings option replaces another language. Paper layouts question type: single multiple choice, rank, long lists code boxes, write-boxes, numeric, date time formats, geographic media questions, acknowledgments. Groups repeat groups, nested numbering (nested_serial_numbers) blank copies repeats (repeat_copies). Question images scaled 2 inches tall, choice images 0.6 inches. missing media choice file triggers one combined warning, missing image prints placeholder. Complex-script fonts chosen text Bengali, Arabic, Devanagari Ethiopic. font_family_cs option overrides choice. Page size, orientation, margins (2 inches), fonts, reference template, title, switches hints, constraints, relevants, choice codes, variable names hidden rows. Bundled examples: inst/extdata/multilang (multilingual, external choice list images) inst/extdata/all_types (every question type feature package renders).

title: convertxlsform 0.2.0 (2025-07-19)
text: Reads survey, choices, settings sheets; errors missing malformed. Preserves HTML/Markdown label, hint, constraint_message via commonmark officer::body_add_html. Document title (form_title) 16 pt bold Arial, centered. “Mandatory questions marked asterisk (*) symbol.” note header. Optional language line. body text 11 pt Arial, left-aligned. Required questions flagged *. Optional nested numbering (number_questions = TRUE) top‑level, groups, repeats. Notes printed Note: … (numbering). Hints images (capped 2″ height) embedded inline. Constraint messages parentheses; relevant clauses appended. select_one / rank: larger hollow‐circle bullets (\u25EF). select_multiple: larger hollow‐square bullets (\u2B1B). select_one_from_file: prints attachment notice. range: generates choices start, end, step. Text / numeric / date / time: bordered text boxes spanning full page width (6.5″), 2–4 empty lines. Media / file / note types: appropriate prompts skips. choices$image provided file exists, embeds bullet (max 1″ height). Missing files trigger warning noted next label.
